name: Ephoto DAM
description: CKEditor 5 integration that lets editors browse the Ephoto digital-asset-management library and embed remote images, videos and documents into content.
project_description:
Ephoto Dam is a solution to centralize your media. Communication departments, your partners, internal or external users can search, manage, share and use digital assets on many media from a single source. Ephoto Dam is scalable and very efficient. Designed to make creative workflows simpler and more efficient. It meets your exact business digital asset management requirements through customization.

 From the Ephoto Dam addon for Drupal, import your images, videos or documents directly into your Drupal CMS in the right format. You thus control the consistency of your brand and guarantee the high availability of your media.
